headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 8, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game, with Gerrit Cole leading the way on the mound. Cole pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 2 earned runs. In other news, the Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Gage Jump leading the way on the mound. Jump pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 11 batters while allowing 2 earned runs.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. Williamson's status will be reassessed after 10 days. Other players who have been placed on the injured list include Cole Wilcox of the Seattle Mariners, Joe Ryan of the Minnesota Twins, Slade Cecconi of the Cleveland Guardians, Chris Murphy of the Chicago White Sox, Joey Bart of the Chicago White Sox, and Luis Urías of the Toronto Blue Jays.

There have been several trades and roster moves in the past few days. The Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins in a trade. The Athletics acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins in exchange for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game. Gerrit Cole led the Yankees to victory with a strong 7.0 innings pitched performance, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Gage Jump leading the way on the mound. Jump pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 11 batters while allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit 3 home runs, including a key 6th homer that scored Brandon Valenzuela.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Williamson's status on the injured list will be reassessed after 10 days.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals after being traded in a deal that brings him to the Midwest.
